notes: Needs ruling (rule 11, cited book): «في كتاب محمد بن يعقوب الكليني» names the book's author; I read him as the first link as the text writes him, and did not decide his status otherwise.

«أخويه محمد وأحمد» are two co-transmitters at one level (the relation «أخويه» is dropped). «أبيهما» is a bare relation. The Imam speaks in Buraid's story («فقال ذاك له»), so he is the last link (owner ruling 5).
